name: Daily Picks
description: Movies and shows picked every day from what your users watch, as a home row and a library for TV apps.

versions.changelog:
Daily Picks plugin for Jellyfin 12.4

Daily movie and show picks based on what users watch: a home row in the web client
and a hard-linked library for native TV apps. Includes taste engine tests and a
release workflow that publishes to a Jellyfin plugin catalog (manifest.json).
